EmailTemplate.subject: Donors Will Race to Give for a FREE Sport Clips Hair Cut Coupon!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.OwnerFullName}
Your blood drive is coming up, and every donation is vital because hospital patients are counting on lifesaving blood products from your drive. We are grateful for your kindness and commitment to helping those in need.
Donors will race to give blood Sept. 1-18 for a Red Cross T-shirt^ (ltd. qty), plus a coupon for a free haircut by email, thanks to Sport Clips Haircuts!^^ For details see rcblood.org/racetogive.
Share this exciting offer to help fill your blood drive schedule today.
As you continue the work to make your drive a success – remember to use these tips:
Fill your schedule. Use these tools to recruit blood donors and schedule them using the Blood Drive Management Portal. Encourage donors to schedule a donation for a friend. Each additional donor scheduled means more lives saved!
If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out – I’m always here to help!
IMPORTANT: Donors MUST have a valid email address on file to receive their reward.
All the best,
{!Contact.OwnerFullName}
P.S. Each Red Cross blood drive and donation center follows a high standard of safety and infection control to protect our partners, donors and staff.
^^ Offer applicable to presenting donors only during the following dates: Sept. 1-30, 2023, and only while supplies last. No substitutions and not transferable by presenting donor. Not redeemable for cash. Offer subject to availability of donation opportunities in presenting donor’s area. Instructions on how to receive the coupon for a free haircut from Sport Clips Haircuts will be sent to the email listed in the presenting donor’s American Red Cross donor profile approximately 10 days after attempted donation. Offer valid at participating Sport Clips locations through Nov. 30, 2023. Limit one (1) per presenting donor unless otherwise indicated. Recipient’s name must be visible if using a printed email. All coupons are subject to merchant terms and conditions, and all trademarks are property of their respective owners. American Red Cross is not responsible for lost, damaged, corrupted or stolen coupons and may replace any such coupons at its sole discretion. Any questions or problems in connection with redeeming the coupon must be directed to the merchant.
^Offer applicable to presenting donors only during the following dates: 09/01/2023-09/18/2023 and while supplies last. Offer subject to availability of donation opportunities in presenting donor’s area. No substitutions and not transferable by presenting donor. Not redeemable for cash.
